prov.text: Net income available to common shareholders of $85.3 million, or $0.88 diluted earnings per share, for the third quarter of 2026 increased $4.2 million, or 5.2%, compared to $81.0 million, or $0.84 diluted earnings per share, for the third quarter of 2025 primarily driven by higher net interest income and lower non-interest expense, partially offset by a higher provision for credit losses. Net income available to common shareholders of $258.1 million, or $2.67 diluted earnings per share, for the first nine months of 2026 increased $133.7 million compared to $124.4 million, or $1.39 diluted earnings per share, for the same period in 2025 due to higher net interest and non-interest income, a lower provision for credit losses and a decline in non-interest expense.

tax.text: For the three months ended September 30, 2026, the effective tax rate was 20.9% compared to 19.1% for the third quarter of 2025, and the provision for income taxes of $23.7 million in the third quarter of 2026 increased $4.0 million, or 20.1% compared to the third quarter of 2025. intro.text: Wesbanco, Inc. (“Wesbanco” or the “Company”), a bank holding company incorporated in 1968 and headquartered in Wheeling, West Virginia, offers a full range of financial services including retail banking, corporate banking, personal and corporate trust services, brokerage services, mortgage banking and insurance. Wesbanco offers these services through two reportable segments, community banking and trust and investment services. For additional information regarding Wesbanco’s business segments, please refer to Note 24, “Business Segments” in the Consolidated Financial Statements.
